cohort: 10 women with an incarcerated gravid uterus who delivered at a single hospital between 2000 and 2019
finding: The prevalence of incarcerated gravid uteri may be higher than previously reported, cases may more likely recover spontaneously, and spontaneous reduction could occur in the third trimester.
mod_finding: This study investigated the management of gravid uterus incarceration, finding a higher incidence than previously reported and observing spontaneous reduction in some cases, suggesting a potential for spontaneous recovery.
